description: Japanese small-clinic Excel workbook with two sheets: 患者 (Patients) and 受診 (Encounters, one row per visit with its diagnosis). Kanji column headers; ICD-10 diagnosis codes. Rows on 受診 are linked to patients through 患者番号. Date cells may be real Excel dates or text in the given format. Times are JST (+09:00). patientId.system follows JP Core (JP_Patient): urn:oid:1.2.392.100495.20.3.51. + "1" + the clinic's 10-digit 医療機関コード — the example uses JP Core's own example code 1312345670; replace it with yours. Sample data: examples/data/jp-clinic.xlsx.
